summary: Consulting firm (ESN) — client missions plus internal engineering. As technical referent: mentoring junior engineers, running technical qualifications and interviews, and authoring a React Native hiring test (Pixelator). Built an internal AI-agent application and championed engineering standards — clean code, SOLID, accessibility — across hexagonal Node.js/TypeScript projects.

Four-year mission (via eXalt-IT) on France's leading beauty-booking platform. Owned the Tap to Pay contactless-payment feature end-to-end (iOS & Android — 18 months, 200+ PRs across 3 repos), built the passwordless Magic Link auth flow, and contributed to the planity.com rebuild and a monorepo serving mobile, tablet and web with multi-country i18n.

Auto-inspection startup. Built web and mobile features across the pro dashboard and mobile app — new Node/Express API routes, role-based access with JOI validation, license-plate blurring via an AWS Lambda (Rekor ai), interactive Google Maps mission tracking, and Cypress/testRigor E2E coverage.
